title: PsyInterviewee: Informational Invariance and Relational Adaptivity in Mental Health Interview Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41289v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based simulated interviewees support interviewer training and the evaluation of mental health interviewing systems. Existing studies have primarily focused on improving human-likeness through richer patient profiles and behavioral modeling. However, human-likeness alone does not establish their reliability. Reliable simulation requires preserving profile-grounded clinical facts (informational invariance) while adapting disclosure and interaction behavior to the interview (relational adaptivity). To this end, we introduce PsyInterviewee, which separates a protected truth channel from a dynamic interaction channel and verifies generated clinical claims against the profile. Specifically, asymmetric write permissions allow dialogue context to update disclosure and behavioral states without authorizing new clinical facts; these states guide what profile-supported information is revealed and how it is expressed. In an automated evaluation

translated_title: PsyInterviewee：心理健康访谈模拟中的信息不变性与关系适应性
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的模拟受访者能够支持访谈员培训以及心理健康访谈系统的评估。现有研究主要通过更丰富的患者档案和行为建模来提升拟人化程度。然而，仅凭拟人化并不足以确立模拟的可靠性。可靠的模拟既需要保留基于档案的临床事实（信息不变性），又需要使信息透露和交互行为适应访谈情境（关系适应性）。为此，我们提出了PsyInterviewee，该方法将受保护的真实信息通道与动态交互通道相分离，并对生成的临床陈述与患者档案进行核对验证。具体而言，非对称写入权限允许对话上下文更新信息透露状态和行为状态，但无权创建新的临床事实；这些状态进一步指导哪些有档案支持的信息被透露以及如何表达。在一项自动化评估中……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PsyInterviewee框架，通过分离受保护的真实信息通道与动态交互通道并采用非对称写入权限机制，在心理健康访谈模拟中同时保证临床事实的信息不变性与交互行为的适应性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PsyInterviewee, which separates a protected truth channel from a dynamic interaction channel via asymmetric write permissions, ensuring both informational invariance of clinical facts and relational adaptivity in mental health interview simulation.
